Hint: Female means gender = 'F'; A11 refers to average salary; Gap = highest average salary - lowest average salary; If the person A's birthdate > B's birthdate, it means that person B is order than person A.
items.gold_sql: SELECT T1.account_id , ( SELECT MAX(A11) - MIN(A11) FROM district ) FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id INNER JOIN client AS T4 ON T3.client_id = T4.client_id WHERE T4.client_id = ( SELECT client_id FROM client WHERE gender = 'F' ORDER BY birth_date ASC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY T2.A11 DESC LIMIT 1
items.predicted_sql:
SELECT
    (SELECT a.account_id
     FROM cn_b7185de16da64408.client AS c
     JOIN cn_b7185de16da64408.disp AS d ON d.client_id = c.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
     JOIN cn_b7185de16da64408.account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
     WHERE c.gender = 'F'
     ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
     LIMIT 1) AS oldest_female_account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(dist.a11) - MIN(dist.a11)
     FROM cn_b7185de16da64408.district AS dist) AS salary_gap
items.answer_text: The oldest female client has account number 271, and the gap between the highest and lowest average salaries is 4,431.

Name the driver with the most winning. Mention his nationality and what is his maximum point scores.
Hint: Full name of the driver refers to drivers.forename and drivers.surname; the most winning refers to MAX(COUNT(wins)); average point scores refers to MAX(points);
items.gold_sql: SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname, T1.nationality, MAX(T2.points) FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T2.wins >= 1 GROUP BY T1.forename, T1.surname, T1.nationality ORDER BY COUNT(T2.wins) DESC LIMIT 1
items.predicted_sql:
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, d.nationality, SUM(ds.wins) AS total_wins, MAX(ds.points) AS max_points
FROM cn_dbd54b57e3f84128.driverstandings AS ds
JOIN cn_dbd54b57e3f84128.drivers AS d ON ds.driverid = d.driverid
GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality
ORDER BY total_wins DESC, max_points DESC
